headline: Diesel crack tops $113/bbl as Europe weighs emergency reserve releases
intro: Diesel's having a moment nobody in Europe wanted — ULSD futures whipsawed after a Wednesday rally, and now Brussels is scrambling over whether to tap strategic reserves under US pressure. Meanwhile refiners are quietly printing money on the spread.
overview: The diesel squeeze remains the dominant storyline: ULSD spot sits near $5/gal with a crack above $113/bbl, Europe is holding emergency talks on releasing strategic fuel stocks, and Morningstar DBRS flags a temporary earnings tailwind for US refiners that could evaporate if Washington imposes a diesel export ban. On the policy side, the Senate's bipartisan permitting deal and a fresh SPR release plan add to a crowded energy-policy agenda, while SAF and renewable-fuel activity continues apace (Gevo's 45Z credit sellout, new synthetic-fuel and eSAF partnerships). Operationally, a fatal coker-area fire at MRPL's Mangalore refinery underscores ongoing refining safety scrutiny alongside the NTSB's findings on the fatal Oregon, Ohio refinery fire.

stories.title: Geopolitics, Diesel Shortages, And Refinery Cuts Shape Energy Markets
stories.summary: ULSD futures saw heavy selling after a big Wednesday rally as diesel-market politics dominate conversation, while RBOB and crude posted modest gains to start October.

stories.title: Europe Holds Emergency Diesel Talks
stories.summary: Key European nations are holding emergency talks on how to respond to US pressure to release strategic fuel reserves amid the diesel shortage.

stories.title: Morningstar DBRS: Global diesel squeeze boosts US refiners
stories.summary: Morningstar DBRS says the global diesel squeeze is creating a strong but likely temporary earnings and cash-flow tailwind for US refiners; a possible US diesel export ban could cut export revenues and alter crude/product markets.

stories.title: US seeks to release another 40 million bbl from SPR despite low inventory levels
stories.summary: The US is seeking to release another 40 million bbl from the SPR despite already-low inventory levels, though there's no guarantee companies will take the full offer.

stories.title: US Senate negotiators reach permitting bill deal, ending yearslong impasse
stories.summary: US Senate negotiators reached a bipartisan permitting bill deal aimed at cutting regulatory delays and litigation uncertainty for energy projects, ending a years-long impasse.

stories.title: Rep, Dem Senators Release Bipartisan Permitting Bill
stories.summary: Senators Lee, Capito, Heinrich, and Whitehouse released the bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act, a permitting reform bill.

stories.title: China Fuel Exporters Cancel Some Cargoes
stories.summary: Chinese fuel exporters canceled some October product cargoes as the country prioritizes domestic supply amid global market upheaval.

stories.title: MRPL refinery fire at coker-adjacent plant kills one, injures another
stories.summary: A fire at MRPL's coker-adjacent delayed coker gas oil hydrotreater unit, triggered by a high-pressure cold separator rupture, killed one worker and seriously injured another.

stories.title: MRPL cuts processing rate at one CDU after fire damages refinery unit: Report; stock extends decline
stories.summary: MRPL cut processing rate at one crude distillation unit after the fire damaged the refinery unit; the company's stock extended its decline.

stories.title: Federal investigators detail ‘many missed opportunities’ to prevent fatal Oregon, Ohio refinery fire
stories.summary: Federal investigators detailed 'many missed opportunities' that could have prevented a fatal refinery fire in Oregon, Ohio.

stories.title: Gevo Announces Sell Out of Substantially All its 2026 Section 45Z Tax Credits
stories.summary: Gevo announced it has sold out substantially all of its 2026 Section 45Z tax credits, contracting $70 million worth and forecasting over $77 million in 2027 credits.

stories.title: Getty Realty Pays $260.9M for 41 Refuel Stores, Betting Big on Texas
stories.summary: Getty Realty paid $260.9 million for 41 Refuel convenience stores, a deal centered on Texas that makes the chain its third-biggest tenant.

stories.title: California illegally spurred “gold rush in cow manure,” lawsuit alleges
stories.summary: A lawsuit alleges California regulators illegally allowed polluters to buy clean fuel credits from large manure-based dairy digesters, calling it a policy that harms poor communities.

stories.title: U.S. electricity use for electric vehicles increasing at a slower pace in 2026
stories.summary: EIA data show US EV electricity consumption growth slowed to 8% in 1H26 from prior 13-24% ranges, following a sales decline after federal EV tax credits expired in September 2025.
